Name: Merchant Pig (Farm Animal)
Author: JigJag
Description:
[center][font=Arial Black]Merchant Pig (Farm Animal) Adds the Traveling Merchant’s purple pig as a farm animal you can purchase from Marnie's Ranch. Haven't you always wanted to own him? The Merchant Pig produces the new Gilded Truffle item! With the Gilded Truffle you can place it in an Oil Maker and make the new Gilded Truffle Oil Artisan Good![/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]⬇ Produce ⬇[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/YUCbIpY.png[/img] [size=5]Gilded Truffle[/size] The Merchant Pig's normal produce. A Gilded Truffle will spawn every 3 Days. [/b][/font][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/ch2OUHQ.png[/img][/b][/font][/center]
[center][b][font=Arial Black]1. Locate your Game Folder, and open the mods folder inside it.[/font][/b][/center]
[center][b][font=Arial Black]2. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/45095?tab=files]Download[/url]﻿ Latest on Nexus or [url=https://github.com/JigJagg22/Merchant-Pig-Farm-Animal-/releases/latest]Download[/url] Latest on GitHub[/font][/b][/center]
[center][b][font=Arial Black]3. Unzip the mod's zip file inside of your Mods Folder.[/font][/b][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]4. ENJOY![/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#cc0000][size=4]WARNING: [/size][/color][color=#ffffff]Uninstalling this mod from an ongoing save will cause any Merchant Pigs, Gilded Truffles, and Gilded Truffle Oils to show as missing items. It is recommended to sell or remove all mod items before uninstalling![/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/g3FAPfv.png[/img][/b]

[center][font=Arial Black][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400?tab=files]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url] Made by Pathoschild[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915?tab=files]Content Patcher[/url] Made by Pathoschild[/b][/font][/center]

[font=Arial Black][img]https://i.imgur.com/2IZTRyz.gif[/img][/font]

[center][font=Arial Black][color=#9900ff][size=6][b]Merchant Pig[/b][/size][/color]
[b]Now you can purchase a pig just like the Traveling Merchant's from Marnie's Ranch for your farm!
The Merchant Pig Produces the new Gilded Truffle item every 3 Days.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/eKry6wM.gif[/img][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#9900ff][size=6]Baby Merchant Pig[/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]Takes 10 days to mature. Hasn't earned his Fez yet.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/mnn0EpY.png[/img][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#f1c232][size=6]Gilded Truffle[/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]A truffle threaded with veins of pure gold. Merchant Pigs have sought these out for generations.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/RfGR2Ma.png[/img][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#f1c232][size=6]Gilded Truffle Oil[/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]A prized Truffle Oil crafted with the Gilded Truffle. It is almost too bright to look at.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZKeIh6i.png[/img][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#f1c232][size=5]Prices:[/size][/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b] A Merchant Pig costs 50,000[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZsXSQp8.png[/img] and sells for 60,000[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZsXSQp8.png[/img] at max Hearts [img]https://i.imgur.com/NurlCFl.png[/img].[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]A Gilded Truffle sells for 1000[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZsXSQp8.png[/img].[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]Gilded Truffle Oil sells for 2200[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZsXSQp8.png[/img].[/b][/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][color=#f1c232][size=5][font=Arial Black][b]Other Notes:[/b][/font][/size][/color][/center]
[center][color=#cc0000][font=Arial Black][b]To buy a Merchant Pig, you require a Deluxe Barn.[/b][/font][/color][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b][color=#cc0000]To produce Gilded Truffles, your Merchant Pig needs to go outside on non-rainy days.[/color][/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]Gilded Truffle Oil takes 1 Day to make from a Gilded Truffle in an Oil Maker.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]This Mod Works with Ongoing Saves.[/b][/font][/center]
[center][font=Arial Black][b]This Mod is also available on GitHub. [url=https://github.com/JigJagg22/Merchant-Pig-Farm-Animal-/releases/latest]CLICK ME![/url][/b][/font][/center]
